overview_description.description:
HeyTea  is a Chinese tea shop that specializes in cheese-topped tea and fruit tea.

In 2012, HEYTEA originated from an alley in the riverside. Originally known as ROYALTEA , the royal tea was completely upgraded to the registered brand HEYTEA.
